name: oneko
title: Oneko
description: Control Oneko, the desktop cat that chases your cursor.
author: miklw

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Cat
commands.subtitle: Oneko
commands.description: Show or hide the cat, starting Oneko if needed.

commands.name: skin
commands.title: Change Skin
commands.subtitle: Oneko
commands.description: Pick the sprite the cat wears.

commands.name: speed
commands.title: Set Speed
commands.subtitle: Oneko
commands.description: Set how fast the cat chases the cursor.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
